results.snippet:
“For Russia, cooperation with China is far more important to withstand Western sanctions effects than cooperation with Iran,” she told RFE/RL, noting that China buys Russian energy and supplies components used in Russia’s defense sector.

Russia’s trade with China surpasses $200 billion annually, dwarfing the single-digit billions traded with Iran.

results.title: The Fallacy of Energy Deals With Russia | Carnegie Endowment for International Peace
results.snippet: Energy insiders understand they operate in an industry that depends on stable long-term investment conditions, as major projects take a long time to execute and generate meaningful return on capital. This is not like real estate, where one can flip a property before generating real economic value. Project timelines are measured in decades and do not fit well with political calendars.
